start.text:
Welcome to the Sample Project — a tiny demo story shipped with Illustrated IF Studio.

You stand at the entrance of an old workshop. Dust drifts in the light. A door leads deeper inside, and a garden path curves away to your right.

Use this project to test the editor, exporters, and players. Replace it with your own game whenever you like.

look_around.speaker: Guide
look_around.text: A friendly voice speaks up: "Everything you see here is editable. Scenes, choices, characters, abilities, art, audio, and theme all live under this project folder."

workshop.text: Inside the workshop, tools hang in neat rows. On the bench rests a small brass key. Picking it up teaches you how the ability system works.

choices.text: Read the notes on the wall

garden.text: The garden opens into a quiet clearing. A locked gate stands at the far end.

choices.text: Open the gate with your curiosity

archive.text: The notes describe how to add scenes, wire choices, and export to HTML, Python, and C++. When you are ready, build something of your own.

ending.text: The gate swings open onto a bright horizon. That's the end of the sample story — now it's your turn to fill in the rest.
